## License / 授權

- [ ] I agree that my data and translations are released under CC0-1.0, and any scripts under Apache-2.0. / 我同意我的資料與翻譯以 CC0-1.0 釋出，腳本以 Apache-2.0 釋出。

## Are you from there? / 你是當地人嗎？

- [ ] I live in (or am from) this region, or speak this language as my first language. / 我住在這個地區，或母語是這種語言。
- [ ] I read every field I changed, and it matches how people really talk there. / 我讀過每個改過的欄位，符合當地人真正的說法。
- [ ] I set `status` to `local_reviewed` and `reviewed_on` to today's date. / 我已把 `status` 改成 `local_reviewed`，`reviewed_on` 填今天日期。

If none of these is ticked, the change stays `draft` and a local person still needs to read it. / 都沒勾也可以，內容維持 `draft`，之後還需要當地人看過。

## Translations / 翻譯

Skip this if you did not change a translation. / 沒有改翻譯就不用勾。

- [ ] I ran the check on my computer and it reported no issues. / 我在自己電腦上跑過檢查，沒有任何問題。
- [ ] I kept every placeholder (such as `{n}`, `{name}`, `%1$s`) and used the words in `source/glossary.json`. / 我保留了所有佔位符（例如 `{n}`、`{name}`、`%1$s`），並照 `source/glossary.json` 的固定用詞。

## No private information / 沒有個資

- [ ] No web addresses, phone numbers, names of real people, or passwords. / 沒有網址、電話、真人姓名或密碼。
